lineage_constraints.claim: The inventory independent_from_nanoda flag is a relation to Nanoda, not proof of semantic independence or no prior observation.

Official and Lean4Lean share official-kernel lineage and the lean4export importer repository at distinct revisions. Different executable names do not remove correlated implementation or reconstruction behavior.

Kiota is locally recorded as from scratch and not a Nanoda fork. That supports the recorded implementation-lineage distinction, not independently established semantics, exhaustive dependency independence, or outcome blindness.

Lean 4.29.1 export production, Lean 4.33.0 logical target, official importer f297dfe, Lean4Lean importer a3e35a5 and four-thread Nanoda profile are distinct bound identities. A new revision or profile requires correspondence and exposure assessment; its changed hash alone is not independence.

CVC reuses Lean4Lean theory with seven retained assumptions in principal comparator reports; executable refinement and arbitrary-byte parsing are not proved. Reusing the same mechanization is not automatically an independent semantic oracle.

conditions: Label the outcomes and semantic family as previously known.
Preserve historical inputs and original result interpretation.

admissible_future_claims.claim: A future outcome cell withheld from a specified design process, conditional on a separate completed exposure and correspondence gate.
conditions: Identify the exact unit being withheld, who has seen what, allowed prior baseline/source knowledge and all related known family outcomes.

local_recommendation.action: Use this exposure ledger as a disqualifier for nominal holdouts; require a concrete unobserved cell plus lineage/target correspondence evidence before any design gate is declared passed.
local_recommendation.target: Parent ALT-TRANSFER assessment, maximum three target routes
prerequisites: Fresh bounded methods/primary-source review owned by parent.
Explicit prior-knowledge and feedback boundary for any proposed route.
If no route clears that boundary, record bounded no-go with the missing prerequisite; no execution or renamed repeat.

verification.limits: This extraction does not validate every transitive historical evidence binding, ignored binary, corpus payload or prior assurance attestation; parent owns required closure validators.

reconsideration_prerequisite.assessment: A separately curated fresh semantic family with a sealed exact input/outcome manifest is one plausible missing input, not a fact established by this local review or sufficient authorization to execute. An already usable existing checker can serve a narrower prospective outcome-cell comparison if the exact cell is demonstrably unobserved by the design process; no whole-implementation holdout should be claimed.
minimum_evidence_needed: An identified usable target and exact semantic/pipeline correspondence for the proposed cell.
A curator and documented selection provenance independent of the prior theorem/let outcomes and current survivor-selection feedback; disclose any known related semantic-family observations.

A dated content-bound input manifest and separately access-controlled outcome record, with who has seen each recorded before design selection; sealing already-known outcomes does not restore blindness.
An accountable owner decision on obtaining that evidence; any external curation request requires target-specific authorization, and any later execution requires its own authorization.
reconsideration_prerequisite.smallest_next_decision: If the parent three-route review finds no qualifying target, pause and ask the owner to select a concrete independent curator/dataset or supply inspectable new target evidence. Do not manufacture an internal holdout by relabeling the known pool or commence another automatic search.
reconsideration_prerequisite.limits: Curator independence, novelty of a family, semantics and target feasibility remain to be demonstrated. A sealed manifest alone is not independence, authority or a new experiment.
